title: System status
description: Android version, device model, uptime, memory and free space

actions.label: Android and model
actions.command:
printf 'Android  %s (API %s)
Device   %s %s
Patch    %s
Kernel   %s
' "$(getprop ro.build.version.release)" "$(getprop ro.build.version.sdk)" "$(getprop ro.product.manufacturer)" "$(getprop ro.product.model)" "$(getprop ro.build.version.security_patch)" "$(uname -r)"

actions.label: Memory
actions.command: awk '/^MemTotal:/{t=$2} /^MemAvailable:/{a=$2} /^SwapTotal:/{st=$2} /^SwapFree:/{sf=$2} END{printf "Memory  %.1f of %.1f GB free\n", a/1048576, t/1048576; if(st>0) printf "Swap    %.1f of %.1f GB free\n", sf/1048576, st/1048576}' /proc/meminfo

actions.label: Temperatures
actions.command: dumpsys thermalservice | awk -F'[=,}]' '/Current temperatures from HAL/{f=1; next} f && /Temperature[{]/{ if($2>0) printf "%-18s %5.1f °C\n", $6, $2; next } f{exit}'
